summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Meeting scheduling feature with Jitsi integration. All backend API tests (18/18) passed. All frontend UI tests passed for Admin, Gestionnaire, and Client dashboards.
critical_code_review_comments: MeetingManager.js and MeetingTab.js components are well-structured with proper state management
API endpoints properly handle role-based access control (admin can create/modify/delete, gestionnaire/client can only view and respond)
Jitsi room names are auto-generated by backend
Email notifications are sent via Gmail SMTP for invitations and responses
seed_data_creation: Test meeting 'TEST_Meeting_E2E_Test' was created and deleted during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Meeting scheduling feature is fully functional. RÉUNIONS tab is visible in all 3 dashboards (Admin/TeacherDashboard, Gestionnaire/GestionnaireDashboard, Client/ClientDashboard). Admin can create/modify/delete meetings. Gestionnaire and Client can view invitations and accept/refuse. Jitsi integration generates room URLs automatically.
